sources.name: droid_failure
sources.real_robot_evidence: Source card identifies failure episodes from the real-robot DROID-COMMUNITY collection, ported from raw DROID 1.0.1 at full resolution.
sources.state_semantics: Seven measured Franka joint positions plus the separately stored measured gripper position.
sources.action_semantics: Seven commanded Franka joint positions plus the separately stored commanded absolute gripper position.
sources.gripper_semantics: DROID absolute command in [0,1], with 0 fully open and 1 fully closed. Values remain source-native.
sources.notes: Production component source. Native 15 Hz commanded actions, so the complete 8D vector is linearly interpolated to 30 Hz and the interpolation mask must be non-zero. Task/language strings are empty, so task identity and failure mode come from proxy review. pilot_episodes is the per-component acceptance target, not a pilot slot count.

sources.name: droid_success
sources.real_robot_evidence: Source card identifies successful DROID-COMMUNITY episodes; DROID is an in-the-wild real Franka collection, ported from raw DROID 1.0.1 at full resolution.
sources.state_semantics: Seven measured Franka joint positions plus the separately stored measured gripper position.
sources.action_semantics: Seven commanded Franka joint positions plus the separately stored commanded absolute gripper position.
sources.gripper_semantics: DROID absolute command in [0,1], with 0 fully open and 1 fully closed. Values remain source-native.
sources.notes: Production component source. Same 15 Hz native commanded actions and 8D vector as droid_failure, so interpolation to 30 Hz runs and the mask must be non-zero. Unlike droid_failure this source carries language: three pipe-separated phrasings per episode. Language is a nomination and cross-check signal, not a substitute for proxy review. Selected primarily for recovery behaviour inside eventual successes per plan Section 1.6, not for additional clean successes.
